subject: Request: Apply trial credit and confirm invoice offset
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.io>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@acme.io
Date: 2028-03-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Apply trial credit and confirm invoice offset

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the recent onboarding session — team is up and running. We have a couple items to tidy up on the billing side before month-end:

- Acme received a trial allowance from Redwood (promotion code RW-ACME-TRIAL) applied to our account.
- We have an outstanding invoice INV-2028-0318 for $24,500 that we would like the trial credit applied against, if possible.

Can you confirm: (1) whether Redwood can issue a credit memo referencing INV-2028-0318, and (2) whether your accounting team will apply the credit as an invoice offset rather than a refund? Our AP team prefers an offset so we don’t have to touch cash.

If you need a PO or statement of work attached, let me know — we can provide. Hoping to get confirmation this week for our March close.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior Finance Manager
Acme Analytics
Priya.Shah@acme.io

[Attachment: Acme-PO-1298.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Apply trial credit and confirm invoice offset

Thanks Priya — looping in finance and billing so we can confirm the exact flow. Quick notes from my side:

- We can absolutely issue a credit memo referencing the invoice number; standard practice is to apply as an invoice offset if the customer prefers.
- Need finance to confirm GLA mapping and whether a manual journal entry is required in your case (some customers prefer an explicit contra-revenue posting).

Marcus/Marissa/Laura — can one of you confirm:
1) Can we issue the credit memo for the full trial allowance and apply it to INV-2028-0318?
2) Preferred ledger accounts for the promo allowance (G/L) and AR offset?
3) Any documentation you need from Acme (PO/approval) before we finalize?

I’ve attached a draft credit memo for reference — please edit as needed.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Redwood-Draft-CreditMemo-834.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.io>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Apply trial credit and confirm invoice offset

Hi Priya / Olga — finance here. Confirming we will:

1) Issue a final credit memo (CreditMemo_834_FINAL.pdf) that references INV-2028-0318 and the promotion code RW-ACME-TRIAL.
2) Apply the credit as an invoice offset against INV-2028-0318 in AR (no cash refund).

Accounting details for your records:
- Credit memo amount: $5,000 (trial allowance)
- Debit: Contra Revenue - Promo Allowance (GL 4105)
- Credit: Accounts Receivable (GL 1200)
- Journal entry will be posted by finance team on 2028-03-05. Ticket: Jira FIN-4521

We received the PO you attached — that’s sufficient documentation. We will:
- Attach the final credit memo to your account and send a copy to accounts-payable@acme.io.
- Post the journal entry and mark INV-2028-0318 as partially satisfied ($5,000 offset).

Attaching the final signed credit memo stub. Reach out if you need the full PDF for your AP system.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: CreditMemo_834_FINAL.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-05T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Apply trial credit and confirm invoice offset

Priya — quick confirmation that we completed the steps below:

- Final credit memo (CreditMemo_834_FINAL.pdf) issued and sent to accounts-payable@acme.io.
- $5,000 applied as an invoice offset against INV-2028-0318. Remaining balance on INV-2028-0318 is $19,500.
- Finance posted the journal entry (Jira FIN-4521) on 2028-03-05; G/L mapping as Marissa outlined (4105 / 1200).

Related links: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/12345 (deal record), Jira FIN-4521 (posting). I’ve attached a short adjustment statement for your AP team.

If you want us to reissue the invoice with the credit applied (stamped copy) we can — say the word and we’ll generate INV-2028-0318-adjustment-statement.pdf for your records.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — glad we could get this squared away before close.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

[Attachment: INV-2028-0318-adjustment-statement.pdf (pdf)]
